queries.sql: SELECT "t0"."id", "t0"."email", "Account_posts"."__prisma_data__" AS "posts" FROM "public"."account" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(JSONB_AGG("__prisma_data__"), '[]') AS "__prisma_data__" FROM (SELECT "t3"."__prisma_data__" FROM (SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('id', "t2"."id", 'title', "t2"."title") AS "__prisma_data__" FROM (SELECT "t1".* FROM "public"."post" AS "t1" WHERE "t0"."id" = "t1"."author" /* root select */) AS "t2" /* inner select */) AS "t3" /* middle select */) AS "t4" /* outer select */) AS "Account_posts" ON true WHERE ("t0"."id" >= $1 AND "t0"."id" < $2)
